printer_agent.tooltip: Choose the network protocol used to talk to your printer.

lines.label: Fan speed-up time
lines.tooltip: How many seconds ahead to spin up the part cooling fan before overhangs or bridges.

lines.label: Print head
lines.tooltip: The 3D print head model used to check for collisions during curved-layer slicing. You can fine-tune it under Calibration › Non-planar › Head clearance.

lines.label: Head shape
lines.tooltip: Customize the dimensions and safety margins of the selected print head and save it as your own profile.

lines.label: Frequency
lines.tooltip: The resonant frequency (Hz) used by input shaping to cancel out frame ringing.

lines.label: Damping
lines.tooltip: Damping ratio (zeta) for the input shaping filter.
